import json, subprocess, sys
BASE = json.load(open("examples/input.json"))
def run(text):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/main.py"], input=text.encode(), capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()[:60]
cases = {
 "nul in id": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"id": "a"', '"id": "a\\u0000"'),
 "tab in id": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"id": "a"', '"id": "a\\t"'),
 "split with escape": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"dev"', '"de\\u0076"'),
 "prob nested list": json.dumps(BASE).replace('[[65536]]', '[[[65536]]]'),
 "time_edges nested": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"time_edges": [\n      0\n    ]', '"time_edges": [[0]]'),
 "packets list of lists": json.dumps(BASE).replace('{"time": 0,\n      "connection": "a",\n      "length": 0,\n      "draw": 0\n    }', '[0, "a", 0, 0]'),
 "conn slot float": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"slot": 0', '"slot": 0.0'),
 "leading zeros": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"time": 0', '"time": 00', 1),
 "plus sign num": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"time": 0', '"time": +0', 1),
 "single quotes": "{'version':1}",
 "trailing comma": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"version": 1,', '"version": 1,,'),
 "comment": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"version": 1', '"version": 1 // c', 1),
 "uppercase E": json.dumps(BASE).replace('"time": 0', '"time": 0E0', 1),
}
for name, text in cases.items():
    print("%-22s" % name, run(text))
